name: Trapper
description:
You are skilled in crafting, setting and concealing a variety of traps. You have 3 traps, which you can set using the Set Trap ability. Each trap can inflict the following effects on a trapped creature:

  • Maul: The trap deals 3d4 damage to the trapped creature.

  • Pierce: The creature rolls Injury.

  • Clamp: The trapped creature's Speed is halved. It may spend an action on its turn to roll Strength against the trap's Difficulty to end this effect.

  • Trip: The trapped creature is knocked prone.

  • Foil: The trapped creature checks a Condition.

Describe how you make and use your traps.

improvements.name: Staked Traps
improvements.description: The Clamp effect instead reduces the trapped creature's speed to 0.
